source.attribution: Data from OpenMercantil (https://openmercantil.es/), derived from BORME / Boletín Oficial del Estado. CC BY 4.0.

access.note: Full bulk CSV/Parquet marked 'Próximamente' at time of analysis; samples, per-company export, and REST API are live.

transport.record_path: $ (CSV rows; full file is act-level, 12 cols)

pagination.note: Bulk file when published (~210 MB, ~5.8M rows). REST API at /api and per-company /export?format=csv&empresa={slug} available now; confirm API pagination from live docs.

snapshot.note: Persist raw CSV/Parquet. Distinguish company-master rows (7 cols) from act-level rows (12 cols).

parsing.notes: cif/slug stay strings; cif often empty. Strip status/registry tags from name for normalized_name. Capital is register share capital (EUR), NOT annual-accounts data.

mapping_rules.company_type: Derive from name suffix / cif leading letter.
mapping_rules.status: Infer from name suffix ('EN LIQUIDACION') and acts; else unknown.

fixture_requirements: company row WITH a valid CIF
company row with EMPTY cif (fallback to slug)
name carrying a status suffix (EN LIQUIDACION)
act-level row from the full 12-column CSV (Capital/Workers/Address populated)

live_test_plan.smoke: Load muestra_empresas_100.csv; assert columns and that ~10-20% rows carry a cif; build normalized rows.
live_test_plan.full: When the bulk file is published, download behind an env gate; persist raw; normalize; split act-level vs company-master.

blockers: Full bulk CSV/Parquet was 'Próximamente' at analysis time — confirm availability before a full run.
Low CIF coverage (~18%) weakens joins to financials.
Community reconstruction — verify authoritative values against BORME / Registro Mercantil.
